leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' critical damage by 5% for each Lantarna character in the party.
leader_skill.name: The Comet Is with Us

character.name: Saskia
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Saskia, an alchemist with a dream—just like Resna. Together, we aim to find the World's End!

character.acquisition_text:
新たな年をみんなで祝えるなんて。
ふふっ……とっても嬉しいわね
character.description:
レスナの錬金術の師匠。
弟子が一人立ちしてからは、自分自身の目的のために世界中を旅している。人と人との繋がりを大事にしており、年の初めには世話になった人々の下へ挨拶に赴き、贈り物をするという律義な一面を持つ。
そんな彼女がどこで生まれ、どう生きてきたのか。知る者は少ない。

leader_skill.description: 得意属性が氷属性のキャラは「魔攻+40%」
leader_skill.name: 身体の芯まで凍らせてあげる

character.name: ザスキア
character.profile_voice_text:
ザスキアよ。一緒に新年を祝えて
嬉しいわ。今年もよろしくね～

character.acquisition_text: I'm said to have the power of a genius—and this time I'll let you use that power for once!
character.description: A young girl who served as an enforcer under the code name Crow in the Moonlight Society, an organization unrecognized by the kingdom. She has lived her life obeying nothing but the words of the organization's leader, Oliver, who is also her only family—her grandfather. She is very confident in her fighting skills, and her prowess in combat is undeniable. She has a strong sense of pride, hates to lose, and can be headstrong, often rushing into situations on her own.

leader_skill.description: Grants Promise & Teamwork characters a high chance to inflict Poison on the target for 1 turn after attacking, and boosts their skill damage to poisoned attack targets by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Never Let Your Prey Escape!

character.name: Johanna
character.profile_voice_text: This is where I belong now. You can trust this genius to keep everything here safe.

character.acquisition_text: I owe you all a great debt. Feel free to make use of my skills.
character.description: An alchemist whose body has been partially transformed into that of a beast. He has no qualms about using his strength to force others into submission, so long as it helps fulfill his desires. Though he doesn't talk much, he changes when it comes to his younger brother, his only family. As an older brother, he's surprisingly caring and responsible, but when it comes to dealing with women, he's rather hopeless.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Quiet characters' P. ATK and P. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Calm Judgment

character.name: Geron
character.profile_voice_text: I am Geron Diezel, an alchemist. I wield this sword for the sake of our future.

character.acquisition_text: This path seems as if it will prove most entertaining. Time for me to add a new chapter to my story.
character.description: An alchemist with the appearance of nobility. She uses alchemy in her ambition to establish the Kingdom of Lara, putting her at odds with Resna, who believes alchemy should be used to bring happiness to others. As a self-proclaimed leader, she is meticulous about maintaining an air of elegance in her appearance, which she believes is appropriate for a queen who leads others.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' battle item damage by 20% for each Prim character in the party.
leader_skill.name: Bow before My Grace!

character.name: Lara
character.profile_voice_text: I am Lara Trockel. A proud queen who will be the foundation upon which unfulfilled souls stand.

character.acquisition_text:
迷えるときは、この背中を追いなさい。
理想の国へ導いて差し上げますわ
character.description:
ララ・キングダムの王にして錬金術士。
各地で優秀な人物を見つけては、ララ・キングダムの臣下として登用しようとしている。少々強引なところはあるが、面倒見がよく臣下や国民からは慕われている。
アンペルと揃いでこの衣装を着ていると、まるで彼を秘書として従えているように見えるため、ちょっと気分がいいらしい。

leader_skill.description: 味方全員は「お嬢様」1人につき「物攻・魔攻+10%」と「スキルダメージ・ブレイクダメージ+20%」
leader_skill.name: いかなるときも優雅たれ

character.name: ララ
character.profile_voice_text:
ララ・トロッケル。王たる者として、
より優美に、華麗に活躍いたしましょう

character.acquisition_text: I swore that I would wield this sword to protect everyone!
character.description: A new alchemy student at Lantarna Academy. She enrolled at the academy via recommendation, but she rarely attends class and doesn't seem to have joined the alchemy club. She's taciturn and rarely mingles with her classmates, instead preferring to be a lone wolf.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Quiet characters' skill damage by 75% when attacking a weakness.
leader_skill.name: The Shadow Who Rescues and Protects

character.name: Eren
character.profile_voice_text: I enrolled here at Lantarna Academy for personal reasons. Will I...fit in here?

character.acquisition_text: If you're unsure, just charge ahead! Dream big! Dream HUGE!
character.description: A trusted vassal of the Kingdom of Lara. Mieke once ran a thriving accessory shop in Wirbel Province, where her designs were especially popular among young women. Captivated by Lara's magnanimity, she left this position and devoted herself entirely to Lara's service. She inherited a cheerful and vivacious personality from her entertainer father, but hates getting stuck on tiny details, always moving forward with bold confidence.

leader_skill.description: Grants Creator characters Initiative and boosts their skill damage by 50%.
leader_skill.name: Flash of Inspiration!

character.name: Mieke
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Mieke, the top wardrobe designer in the Kingdom of Lara! Leave anything fashion-related to me!

character.acquisition_text: These fierce flames that burn within me... I'll turn them into a melody for all to hear!
character.description: A trusted vassal of the Kingdom of Lara. Gifted with musical talent, Diona rose to fame as a young diva. She first met Mieke in Wirbel Province, their hometown, where the two became close friends who recognized each other's talents. Inspired by Lara's elegance and grace, Diona has sworn absolute loyalty to her. She has a strong sense of aesthetics and feels unsettled whenever she sees something that disturbs the beauty of the world.

leader_skill.description: Boosts all allies' Paralysis resistance by 100% and boosts their skill damage by 50% when their attack target is paralyzed.
leader_skill.name: Captivated by the Queen

character.name: Diona
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Diona. Would you like to hear me sing? Very well, let me sing in praise of Lady Lara...

character.acquisition_text: Heh. Bring it on. No matter who my opponent is, I'll smash 'em to bits!
character.description: A renowned fighter, widely known as "Brawl Master Magda." Formerly a member of the Moonlight Society, she is acquainted with Valeria and others. Confident in her physical strength, she finds purpose in earning her keep through sheer skill. Magda has her own personal code when it comes to work, and will outright refuse jobs she doesn't feel are worth taking. Though her personality can be rough around the edges, she always cares for those close to her. She also has a quieter side that enjoys listening to music as a pastime.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Adventurer characters' P. ATK and M. ATK by 10% and skill damage and stun damage by 30%.
leader_skill.name: Smash, Smash, and Smash Some More!

character.name: Magda
character.profile_voice_text: The name's Magda, brawler for hire. Got a job? I'll take it—but my bat doesn't come cheap.

character.acquisition_text: I shall judge your efforts with my own eyes. After all, that is my duty.
character.description: A young man appointed as the Seneschal of Alchemy at an early age. He has been sent by the kingdom to Resna and her companions as an overseer to determine whether they can achieve the restoration of alchemy. Though he considers Roman a friend from their school days, he also sees him as a rival—albeit one-sidedly. While he maintains a calm and composed demeanor, he carries an intense passion deep within.

leader_skill.description: After Lantarna characters attack, boosts their target's Stab damage received by 20% for 1 attack.
leader_skill.name: Keen Eye for Weakness

character.name: Brad
character.profile_voice_text: I am Bradley Khan. I've recently been appointed the Seneschal of Alchemy. Pleased to make your acquaintance.

character.acquisition_text: I'm still not used to standing out here in the sunlight, but I want to stay close to those who matter most...
character.description: An alchemist cloaked in an aura of darkness. She admires Criselda, the leader of the Polar Night Alchemists, regarding her as a close friend and assisting her for some time now. She also loves playing with dolls, having given names to the four dolls that she always keeps by her side. Vindictive by nature, she never forgets a deed done to her—whether it be a gesture of kindness or an act of betrayal.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Bolt affinity characters' P. ATK, M. ATK, P. DEF, and M. DEF by 25%.
leader_skill.name: Puppeteer's Devotion

character.name: Antje
character.profile_voice_text: I'm Antje, an alchemist... Nice to meet you. Come now, everyone, say hello.

character.acquisition_text: My wish is to know everything in this world. I'd be honored if you'd lend me your aid!
character.description: An alchemist with the mind of a researcher. Driven by an insatiable thirst for knowledge, he constantly seeks new discoveries. He despises being interrupted in his research, which often brings him into conflict with Resna and the others. Though his personal life suffers because he is always engrossed in research, his refined upbringing is evident in his everyday mannerisms.

leader_skill.description: Boosts Glasses characters' burst skill damage by 100%.
leader_skill.name: Seeker of Knowledge's Favorite Specs

character.name: Walther
character.profile_voice_text: I am Walther, an alchemist and seeker of knowledge. I possess more than enough common sense, so worry not.

character.acquisition_text:
私のすべてを、あなたに預けるわ
――ふふっ、たっぷり楽しませてね
character.description:
「極夜の錬金党」の党首。
各地で素材の独占・強奪を繰り返し、己の渇望を満たすために錬金術の研究をしていた。
敵対する者に対しては非情に振る舞うが、協力的な人間には惜しみない援助を送る。料理が得意で、意外と面倒見のいい一面も。
character.fullname: クリセルダ・アメルハウザー

leader_skill.description: 得意属性が雷属性のキャラは「攻撃対象がブレイク状態の時、スキルダメージ+100%」
leader_skill.name: 私たちの渇望のために

character.name: クリセルダ
character.profile_voice_text:
私はクリセルダ。紆余曲折はあったけど……
ふふっ、仲良くしてくれると嬉しいわ

character.acquisition_text:
故郷への想いと、姉様への想い――
どちらも背負って、私は強くなる
character.description:
ノーヴァ神聖国で「聖戦士」を務める少女。
アルビーナを「姉様」と呼び、血は繋がっていないが本当の姉妹のように慕っている。
クールでミステリアスな雰囲気を纏っているが、天然なところがあり、奇抜な行動で周囲を驚かせることも。

leader_skill.description: 「無数島群域」は「物攻・魔攻+50%」
leader_skill.name: 復讐を誓う若き戦士

character.name: ベップ
character.profile_voice_text:
ベップ・ジムロック。ノーヴァ神聖国の
聖戦士にして、アルビーナ姉様の護衛役よ

character.acquisition_text:
未知なる冒険へ、アタシが案内してあげる！
……なーんてね
character.description:
ノーヴァ神聖国の「星の案内人」にして、錬金術士。
島にやってきた錬金術士と出会ったことをきっかけに、錬金術にのめり込むようになる。神聖国では各人の「天命」として決められた仕事以外への従事は禁じられているため、錬金術士としての活動は周囲に隠している。
頭の回転が速く口も達者で、よく悪知恵が働く。
character.fullname: アルビーナ・ジムロック

leader_skill.description: 「無数島群域」は「物攻・ブレイクダメージ+30%」
leader_skill.name: 星の案内人

character.name: アルビーナ
character.profile_voice_text:
アルビーナだよ！　ノーヴァ神聖国の
星の案内人にして……駆け出しの錬金術士！
